project_type: Laravel 10 + Blade + Livewire monolith, no compiled frontend (Tailwind CDN, Alpine.js CDN)
language: PHP 8.x / Blade templates / vanilla CSS in <style> blocks
build_system: Composer only. No Vite/Mix/webpack. CSS is inline <style> blocks or CDN. No build step required.
test_framework: No automated frontend tests. Verification is manual browser testing at DevTools breakpoints.
test_command: Manual: Chrome DevTools → Device toolbar → 375px / 768px / 1440px viewport widths
verification_instructions: 1. Open Chrome DevTools, toggle device toolbar, set to 375×812. 2. Navigate each changed page and confirm no horizontal scrollbar. 3. Test sidebar hamburger opens/closes. 4. Set to 768px and confirm grid transitions. 5. Set to 1440px and confirm desktop layout unchanged. For DataTables bugs: ensure DB table has 0 rows for the relevant model, then load the page and check browser console for 'Incorrect column count' error — should be absent after fix.
environment_constraints: Do NOT change PHP logic, routes, or controller code. Preserve all element id= attributes. Keep all Alpine.js x-* and wire: attributes untouched. Do NOT alter desktop layout at >=1024px. All CSS changes are additive @media overrides inside <style> blocks appended to the file.
contribution_requirements: Option A (add @media query override <style> blocks) for all pages using inline styles. Option B (replace inline with Tailwind responsive classes) ONLY for layouts/app.blade.php which already uses Tailwind CDN classes.
key_patterns: 1. Most pages are standalone <!DOCTYPE html> files with a partials/head.blade.php include that provides the shared CSS design system (CSS variables, .w container, .btn, .card, .badge, grid helpers). 2. Grids are controlled by named classes like .stats-g, .feat-g, .price-g with a trailing <style> block in the same file. 3. Sidebar dashboards (tutor/student/parent/admin) all use Alpine x-data={sidebarOpen:false} with fixed-position sidebar + mob-overlay pattern. 4. All DataTables initialized via initDataTable() helper in partials/datatables-assets.blade.php. 5. Public pages use partials/nav.blade.php (already responsive) and partials/footer.blade.php (already responsive). 6. Admin pages extend layouts/admin.blade.php (already has mobile sidebar). 7. Guest pages extend layouts/guest.blade.php (auth card already responsive, only small grid fixes needed).
directory_structure: tutor-platform/resources/views/ — layouts/ (app, admin, guest), partials/ (nav, footer, head, datatables-assets), pages/ (home, tutors/, dashboard/, admin/, bookings/, group-sessions/, examiner-clinic*, library/)
